title: Body Parts
label: ch:ta-body-parts
canDo: I can say head and hand in Tamil, account for why both stayed native here where Hindi's pair came from Sanskrit, and write நன்றி from its pieces.

payoff.summary: Say talai and kai, then state the contrast with Hindi's Sanskrit-descended pair.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: TA-C13-udal-uruppugal (560) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses its own atom. The other five — க (TA-SCRIPT-DRIZZLE-06, TA-S06-ka, 565), the ி sign and a hand-written நன்றி (TA-SCRIPT-I-SIGN-WRITE-NANDRI-01/-02, TA-SOUND-I-SIGN-WRITE-NANDRI-03, TA-W04-i-sign-write-nandri, 570) and ர (TA-SCRIPT-RECOG-117, TA-S117-letter-ra, 571) — are taught by script lessons sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and none of those lessons is a fitting payoff for head and hand.
